decisions.subject: Heavyweight book
decisions.lean: Flagship executed a wholesale rotation on 07-01: it closed its entire industrial/cyclical conviction cluster (APH, URI, AIT, CSL, CI, WAB, UNP, PH, KMT, etc. — all 'removed from book') and rebuilt around a tech/AI-led book. Six of my eight holdings left the tradable universe entirely, forcing a near-total rebuild. Rather than chase the 15 fresh, one-day-old, single-lens (1/1 confluence) conviction opens indiscriminately, I press Flagship's HIGHEST-confidence layer: the seasoned, trend-confirmed leadership sleeve (SMH, XLK, IWM — 97-99th pctile RS, held since inception) forms the anchor, and I use the concentrated single-name slots only for the shallowest-bear-tail mega-cap quality (MSFT, GOOGL, META, TSM) plus one genuinely distinct bottleneck-migration node (GEV = AI power/electrification). I deliberately drop the redundant momentum wrapper (MTUM), the higher-beta/lower-quality names (AMD, DELL, ENTG, and the airlines AAL/DAL/LUV), and MRK — a lagging defensive that isn't a winner. The book is a decisive, confirmation-over-prediction bet on the confirmed AI/tech leadership, with IWM for breadth and ~11% cash as cleaner ballast than dead-weight pharma given the single-names carry only one-day, one-lens confirmation.
decisions.thesis: Forced sales (left Flagship's universe, all 'removed from book' in today's rotation): AIT, APH, CI, CSL, URI, WAB — the entire industrial/reshoring/rentals/distribution cluster my prior book was built on. Also dropping MRK (still in-universe but a lagging defensive, not a winner — replaced by cash as ballast). Kept and re-anchored on SMH (my one surviving leadership holding). The industrial cyclical thesis was invalidated by Flagship's own rotation, not by my mark; I follow the confirmed leadership rather than fight the desk's read.

decisions.subject: China book
decisions.lean: Defensive-but-participating rebalance for 2026-07-02. The CN drawdown radar is CAUTION (sleeve ×0.90, breadth breakdown 'all-boats') and the regime is stagflation pending a shift to reflation, so I keep ~38% cash — but I stop letting 44% sit idle and concentrate the invested book into the one theme with a confirmed, accelerating signature: Innovative Pharma & CXO (+27.4% 20d vs CSI 300). The healthcare core — 振德医疗 (603301.SS, top corroborated alpha leader), 药石科技 (300725.SS/SZ, CXO uptrend), 京新药业 (002020.SZ, my +17% winner) — anchors the book, extended by two confirmed-uptrend adds, 生物股份 (600201.SS, animal-health) and 石药创新 (300765.SZ, innovative pharma). 中际旭创 (300308.SZ) stays as my sole AI-optics exposure at a reduced, no-add weight — its theme is rolling-over (sizing context only) but it remains a corroborated alpha leader with the global AI-semis confirmer ON. 三七互娱 (002555.SZ) is a deliberate non-healthcare diversifier off the highest entry-timing corroboration on the board (BUY-ZONE now). This is confirmation-over-prediction: I follow what has already turned up, size down for the caution sleeve, and cut what the desks have abandoned.
decisions.thesis: Exited 养元饮品 (603156.SS): the Food & Beverage theme is desk-labelled 'deteriorating' / rolling-over with reco 'avoid' (breadth weakening, below 50d) — the desk has demoted the theme itself, and I have no independent edge to override it, so I stop holding dead money there. Exited 海康威视 (002415.SZ): it sits in no published basket, carries zero desk corroboration in today's intake, and in a breadth-breakdown caution tape I'd rather recycle the capital into names the desks are actually confirming than hold an un-themed drifter.

decisions.subject: China book
decisions.lean: Defensive-but-honest rebalance into an extreme-fear HK tape. HK sits in a growth-scare quadrant — weak peg, mainland-led risk-off, decoupled from a benign US backdrop — and EVERY theme I hold is rolling-over. Confirmation over prediction: nothing has confirmed an up-turn, so I do not force my ~62% cash into faltering themes, but I do trim what is clearly failing. Actions: (1) trim the H-bank trade — ICBC (1398.HK) 5.9%→3.5% and Bank of China (3988.HK) 4.8%→3.0% — because the Banks theme is both rolling-over and extended at the 99th RS percentile and these are my two worst positions; (2) hold my winners — CSPC Pharmaceutical (1093.HK, +8.3%) rides despite a 'deteriorating' theme label because the tape is confirming and the label has ~zero rank-IC, and China Life (2628.HK), my top conviction and the only corroborated buy-board name (UPTREND, alpha 0.82), stays roughly flat at half-entry discipline; (3) hold Tencent (0700.HK) as the liquid China-tech anchor most levered to any HK snap-back; (4) add a small new defensive toe-hold in Power Assets (0006.HK), a low-beta utility the board flags as nearing a low with mainland accumulation. Net book ~36% invested / ~64% cash — a deliberate underweight vs FXI, justified by the extreme-fear tape and the absence of any confirmed theme turn. Falsifier: if HK breadth turns up and my rolling-over themes flip to confirming (net-new-highs/50d guards arming), this defensiveness is wrong and I redeploy cash into the leaders.
decisions.thesis: Trimmed both H-banks into their rolling-over-and-extended theme: ICBC (1398.HK) 5.9%→3.5% and Bank of China (3988.HK) 4.8%→3.0%, my two worst positions (-6.3% / -8.0%). No full exits — kept residual bank exposure for the oversold-cyclical mean-reversion optionality the macro brief describes. Redeployed a small slice of the trim into a new defensive starter, Power Assets (0006.HK).
